question: Radha Sridhar won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 in ________.
solution:
The correct answer i__s____** **__**Bharatnatyam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• Radha Sridhar received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2018 for her contribution to Bharatanatyam. 
 
• Bharatnatyam:-
 
 
• The dance origin can be traced back to Sadir-the solo dance of temple dancers or devadasis in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatnatyam is also known as Dashiattam.
 
• Elements of Bharatnatyam
 
 
• Alarippu-seeking blessing of god with simple dance steps in rhythm.
 
• Jatiswaram-Nritta component with devoid expression.
 
• Shabdam-dramatic element with expressed words.
 
• Varnam-combination of dance and emotion to express a story.
 
• Padam-mastery over abhinaya of a spiritual message by the artist.
 
• Jawali-Its performed at short love lyrics at a fast tempo.
 
• Thillana-Its is known as the concluding Stage with pure dance(Nritta).
